Good to know

When will my order arrive?

In stock and ready now — orders ship within 1–2 business days and arrive in 2–5 business days via Royal Mail. You're charged securely at checkout.

What size are they?

Each bracelet is hand-strung on a fine gold-tone chain that fastens with a clasp and a loop extender chain, comfortable from roughly 14–19cm.

What are they made of?

4mm faceted crystal beads hand-strung on a gold-tone chain with a single delicate charm.

Shipping & delivery?

UK shipping £1.49, free over £12 (and free with the 5-bracelet stack). Delivery 2–5 business days after dispatch.

Good to know

Your questions, answered

Are you online only?

No — Karmi Laven is part of Melbe Home UK Ltd, an established UK retailer with physical shops across England. karmilaven.com is our online home for the soft gradient bracelet collection; the same brand, the same crystals, online and in store.

Where are your shops?

You'll find Melbe Home in Watford (Harlequin Shopping Centre), Bracknell (The Lexicon), and Guildford (White Lion Walk) — with more locations planned for 2026. Pop in and see the full range in person.

Where are the bracelets made?

Each bracelet is hand-strung in Turkey using crystals selected for colour accuracy and shine. We're a UK brand — designed, bought, and sold here — and we're proud of the craft behind every piece.

How do multi-buy savings work?

The more you add to your bag, the less each bracelet costs — 2 for £5.50 · 3 for £7.50 · 6 for £15. Savings are applied automatically at checkout. Mix any colours you like.

When will my order arrive?

We ship from our UK warehouse within 1–2 business days. Standard UK delivery takes 2–5 days. Free shipping on orders over £12 (or any 6-bracelet bundle).

Can I return or exchange?

Yes — we offer a 30-day hassle-free return on all online orders. Items must be unworn and in original condition. See our Shipping & Returns page for full details.
